Index: backend/Dockerfile
===================================================================
--- backend/Dockerfile	
+++ backend/Dockerfile	
@@ -1,34 +1,45 @@
-FROM php:8.3-fpm
+FROM php:8.4-fpm
 
 RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y \
     libzip-dev \
     libpq-dev \
     libsqlite3-dev \
+    libxml2-dev \
     unzip \
     git \
     curl \
     && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
 
 RUN docker-php-ext-install \
     pdo \
     pdo_pgsql \
     pdo_sqlite \
     zip \
     opcache \
     pcntl
 
+RUN pecl install redis-6.2.0 && docker-php-ext-enable redis
+
 RUN curl -sS https://getcomposer.org/installer -o /tmp/composer-setup.php && \
     php /tmp/composer-setup.php --install-dir=/usr/local/bin --filename=composer && \
     rm /tmp/composer-setup.php
 
+# Configure PHP to suppress deprecation warnings (works for PHP 8.0+)
+RUN { \
+    echo "error_reporting = E_ALL & ~E_DEPRECATED & ~E_WARNING"; \
+    echo "display_errors = Off"; \
+    echo "log_errors = On"; \
+    echo "ignore_repeated_errors = Off"; \
+} > /usr/local/etc/php/conf.d/docker-php-errorreporting.ini
+
 WORKDIR /var/www/html
 
 COPY . /var/www/html
 
 RUN composer install --no-dev --optimize-autoloader --no-interaction
 
 RUN chown -R www-data:www-data /var/www/html
 
 EXPOSE 8000
 
-CMD ["php", "artisan", "serve", "--host=0.0.0.0", "--port=8000"]
\ No newline at end of file
+CMD ["php", "artisan", "serve", "--host=0.0.0.0", "--port=8000"]

@@ -1,60 +1,60 @@
 <?php
 
 return [
 
     /*
     |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
     | Default Broadcaster
     |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
     |
     | This option controls the default broadcaster used by the framework for
     | broadcasting. You may set this to "pusher" or "redis" or "log" or
     | "array" or "null" for the default. If you choose "null", all events
     | will be broadcast through the log, but not actually delivered.
     */
 
-    'default' => env('BROADCAST_DRIVER', 'pusher'),
+    'default' => env('BROADCAST_DRIVER', 'log'),
 
     /*
     |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
     | Broadcast Connections
     |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
     |
     | This is where you may define all of the broadcast connections supported
     | by your application. A default connection of "null" is provided for
     | your convenience. You may add more connections as needed.
     */
 
     'connections' => [
 
         'pusher' => [
             'driver' => 'pusher',
             'key' => env('PUSHER_APP_KEY'),
             'secret' => env('PUSHER_APP_SECRET'),
             'app_id' => env('PUSHER_APP_ID'),
             'options' => [
                 'cluster' => env('PUSHER_APP_CLUSTER', 'mt1'),
                 'useTLS' => false,
                 'host' => '127.0.0.1',
                 'port' => 6001,
                 'scheme' => 'http'
             ],
         ],
 
         'redis' => [
             'driver' => 'redis',
             'connection' => 'default',
         ],
 
         'log' => [
             'driver' => 'log',
             'channel' => env('LOG_CHANNEL'),
         ],
 
         'null' => [
             'driver' => 'null',
         ],
 
     ],
 
 ];
\ No newline at end of file
